description: This file contains unit tests for the `Router` class in the litellm package, focusing on initialization, client creation, timeout behaviors, environment support, and provider compatibility. It tests various configurations and edge cases to ensure proper setup and error handling for different models and provider combinations.

classes.name: Router
classes.description: Main class being tested, responsible for managing models, clients, and configurations in the litellm system.

methods.name: test_init_clients
methods.description: Tests initialization of multiple client types with different timeouts and ensures clients are created correctly for specified models.

methods.name: test_init_clients_basic
methods.description: Verifies basic client initialization without optional timeout or retries parameters.

methods.name: test_init_clients_basic_azure_cloudflare
methods.description: Tests initialization with models configured for Azure Cloudflare endpoints, ensuring clients are correctly instantiated.

methods.name: test_timeouts_router
methods.description: Ensures that the router correctly raises timeout errors when configured with very low timeouts and a completion call is made.

methods.name: test_stream_timeouts_router
methods.description: Verifies correct client selection based on stream timeout configurations and tests streaming completion responses.

methods.name: test_xinference_embedding
methods.description: Tests if Xinference models are initialized with correct API base URLs and are recognized as OpenAI-compatible providers.

methods.name: test_router_init_gpt_4_vision_enhancements
methods.description: Checks that special parameters like base_url and data sources are correctly incorporated for GPT-4 vision models and extensions.

methods.name: test_openai_with_organization
methods.description: Validates that organization headers are correctly set in clients and responses fail or succeed as per organization permissions.

methods.name: test_init_clients_azure_command_r_plus
methods.description: Ensures that for specific Azure models, the clients instantiated are using the OpenAI provider as required.

methods.name: test_aaaaatext_completion_with_organization
methods.description: Tests asynchronous text completion with organization headers to ensure proper request setup and error handling.

methods.name: test_init_clients_async_mode
methods.description: Verifies that in async-only mode, only asynchronous clients are initialized, and synchronous clients are skipped.

methods.name: test_init_router_with_supported_environments
methods.description: Checks that the router correctly filters models based on the environment variable `LITELLM_ENVIRONMENT` and their supported environments list.
